nodes.title: SG-8.4.1 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack and modules
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still says the repo holds only README.md with 'hello Worldseed', carries a Traceability index and has 13 UNKNOWN placeholders. The code now has game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs/GDD.md and the Go backend/. Desired behavior: context.md names the real stack and lists only existing module paths. Expected result: the contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass. Why: the final docs step of the refactor must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the rewritten context.md, when it is scanned for 'hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index' or 'UNKNOWN', then no match is found.
- Given the Stack section, when checked against STACK_TERMS and /\bGo\b/, then TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest and Go are all named.
- Given the module table, when its paths are resolved from the repo root, then game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ are listed and exist.
- Given game/frontend, when contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests run, then all pass.


## Scope
- In scope: Rewrite of repo-root context.md
- In scope: Confirming the docsCheck and contextDoc helper contracts
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and API
- Out of scope: Gameplay or UI changes
- Out of scope: Other SG-8.4 steps (quality gates, SG-8.4.4, SG-8.4.5)
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: No test deleted or skipped
- Preserve: Every source file in game/src and game/frontend/src at most 200 lines


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; the phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/frontend
- No source file over 200 lines; game/src never imports game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope and only referenced as a module path
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- context.md has no stale text, no UNKNOWN, the real stack and real module paths
- contextStack, contextDoc and contextPaths tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md names the real stack and drops README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: docsCheck.ts exports STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT; contextStack.test.ts and contextDoc.test.ts read the repo-root context.md. Desired behavior: Stack lists the real technologies, with Go for backend/. Expected result: no 'hello Worldseed', no 'Traceability index', no UNKNOWN (all 13 removed). Why: the doc must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [].
- Given context.md, when matched with /\bGo\b/, then it matches.
- Given context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [].
- Given context.md, when matched with /UNKNOWN/, then there is no match.


## Scope
- In scope: Purpose, Stack, Entry points, Workflows and trace sections of context.md
- Out of scope: Changing STACK_TERMS entries
- Preserve: docsCheck exports and their tests


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- backend/ and the contribution API are out of scope


## Definition of done
- contextStack and the stack assertions in contextDoc pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists only the real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: contextModulePaths in contextDoc.ts extracts backticked game/ and backend/ paths from table rows; contextPaths.test.ts resolves them against the repo root. Desired behavior: the old README.md and .gitignore rows are replaced by the four real rows. Expected result: every path exists. Why: references must not point at missing files.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result includes game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given those paths, when missingPaths checks them with existsSync from the repo root, then it returns [].


## Scope
- In scope: Modules table in context.md
- Out of scope: Creating new directories or docs
- Preserve: game/docs/GDD.md content


## Technical constraints
- backend/ is listed as the Go service and out of scope
- game/src never imports game/frontend


## Definition of done
- contextPaths and the module-path assertions in contextDoc pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
